summary: Piecewise-linear lookup-table noise generator. Maps the input a2 to a table index v4 = floor(a2 * 16.0) via CRTFtol, issues an interrupt dispatch, and returns 1.0 when the index is out of the 16-entry table (v4 >= 16). Otherwise reads two adjacent float samples from the table embedded in this (samples at this[1419] and this[1420], i.e. float offset 0x162C; the next sample is 1.0 at the final index 15) and linearly interpolates between them with fraction a2 * 16.0. When the blend parameter a3 >= 0, both samples are first passed through the per-sample transform sub_5881F0.

local_names.v5: next-table-sample value (1.0 at index 15, else this[v4+1420])
local_names.v7: copy of v5 retained for the transform path
local_names.a2: noise input scaled by 16.0 to index the table
local_names.a3: blend parameter; when >= 0 the samples are transformed by sub_5881F0

operations.description: Compute the lookup index v4 = CRTFtol(a2 * 16.0).
Call InterruptDispatch each noise sample to service runtime dispatch/interrupt checks.
Out-of-range guard: if v4 >= 0x10 the index is outside the 16-entry table and the function returns 1.0.
Load the current table sample v9 = this[v4 + 1419]; load the next sample as v5 = 1.0 when v4 == 15 (table edge) else this[v4 + 1420].
Conditional transform guard: when a3 >= 0.0, apply sub_5881F0 to both samples before interpolating.
Run the per-sample transform: sub_5881F0(v9) on the current sample and sub_5881F0(v7) on the retained next-sample value.
Return the linear interpolation result (v5 - v9) * (a2 * 16.0) + v9.
Invoked by sub_495DC0 (0x00495DC0) to produce per-sample noise for the collision damage system.
